mintAuthority.summary: HOLLAR is minted on the Hydration appchain by depositing DOT/ETH/BTC/stablecoin collateral into an Aave v3 (GHO-derived) money market, with the HOLLAR Stability Module anchoring the peg; Hydration governance controls collateral and risk parameters.

upgradeability.controlRef: Hydration OpenGov root track runtime upgrade origin

controls.label: Hydration Aave-v3 fork money market (minter)
controls.capDescription: The Hydration Market facilitator 0x8c0f3b9602374198974d2b2679d14a386f5b108e has a 13,000,000 HOLLAR bucket capacity at Hydration block 15249643. The launch borrowing cap was 2,000,000 HOLLAR; the current token also lists HOLLAR Stability Module, HOLLAR FlashMinter, GIGAHDX and BIL facilitators, each with its own capacity.
controls.evidence: Pinned Hydration block 15249643 on 2026-10-01: getFacilitator labels this address Hydration Market; getFacilitatorBucket returns capacity 13000000e18. GhoToken.mint enforces each facilitator's bucketCapacity, while BUCKET_MANAGER_ROLE can change capacities. getFacilitatorsList returns five facilitators, so the money market is not the sole mint path. hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xaa7e0000000000000000000000000000000aa7e0) returns true.

controls.label: Hydration governance / parameter admin
controls.capDescription: Hydration governance sets collateral onboarding, risk parameters, supply caps, and the HSM configuration; HOLLAR is governed by Hydration rather than Polkadot OpenGov directly.
controls.evidence: Coverage notes HOLLAR is governed by Hydration (not DOT holders), which controls collateral rules, risk parameters, and the on-chain HOLLAR Stability Module. Hydration's pinned runtime source configures HSM AuthorityOrigin as Root, EconomicParameters, or GeneralAdmin.

controls.label: Hydration OpenGov root track runtime upgrade origin
controls.evidence: Hydration's runtime composes System, ConvictionVoting, Referenda, Origins, Whitelist, and Dispatcher, and its pinned governance configuration defines a `root` referendum track. Runtime code changes are Root-origin operations, so the root OpenGov track is the on-chain governance route that can replace the runtime minting logic. At Hydration block 13133392, state_getRuntimeVersion reported hydradx specVersion 428.

controls.label: HOLLAR Stability Module facilitator
controls.capDescription: At Hydration block 15249643, getFacilitatorBucket returns an 18,000,000 HOLLAR capacity for this facilitator; its own capacity-management authority was not independently resolved.
controls.evidence: Pinned token reads on 2026-10-01 label this registered facilitator HOLLAR Stability Module and establish its current bucket capacity. eth_getCode returns no EVM bytecode at this address; that does not prove EOA control of a runtime-native facilitator. Its controller type and protective controls remain unknown. The GhoToken source permits facilitator minting within its bucket; these observations do not establish the HSM asset allocation or full collateral denominator.

controls.label: HOLLAR FlashMinter facilitator
controls.capDescription: At Hydration block 15249643, this facilitator has a 100,000 HOLLAR bucket capacity and zero bucket level; flash-loan enforcement and its own capacity-management authority were not independently re-audited.
controls.evidence: Pinned token reads on 2026-10-01 label this registered facilitator HOLLAR FlashMinter and return capacity 100000e18 and level zero. A zero observed level does not prove that it lacks native mint authority.

controls.label: GIGAHDX HOLLAR facilitator
controls.capDescription: At Hydration block 15249643, this registered facilitator has capacity and bucket level of 533,333 HOLLAR; its collateral-gating and administration were not independently resolved.
controls.evidence: Pinned token reads on 2026-10-01 label this registered facilitator GIGAHDX and return capacity and level 533333e18. The bucket observation identifies a native mint path, not the assets backing its liabilities.

controls.label: BIL HOLLAR facilitator
controls.capDescription: At Hydration block 15249643, this registered facilitator has a 950,000 HOLLAR bucket capacity; its collateral-gating and administration were not independently resolved.
controls.evidence: Pinned token reads on 2026-10-01 label this registered facilitator BIL and return capacity 950000e18. The full collateral and administrative path remains unverified; no stronger protective-control claim is made.

review.evidence: Hydration press and coverage describe HOLLAR as an Aave-v3/GHO-derived overcollateralized stablecoin with the native HSM for peg support, governed by Hydration with parameter-level control over collateral and caps. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: collateral-gated issuance is capped but Hydration OpenGov can raise caps and upgrade runtime logic; no off-chain reserve claim or prudential supervisor applies.
review.reviewer: Claude Phase 0c continuation; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-3 (lead usds-sky) (2026-07-20); Sol economic-posture batch 2026-08-15
review.sourceFreeRationale: Aave-v3/GHO fork mint design is documented by Hydration. Pinned Hydration block 15249643 on 2026-10-01 confirms DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE at 0xaa7e0000000000000000000000000000000aa7e0 and five facilitator entries: Hydration Market, HOLLAR FlashMinter, HOLLAR Stability Module, GIGAHDX and BIL. The previously recorded admin address omitted its final zero. The historical pinned runtime source records HSM AuthorityOrigin as Root, EconomicParameters or GeneralAdmin and a root referendum track. Current state_getRuntimeVersion returns hydradx specVersion 447; this version observation does not independently bind the historical source commit to current runtime code.
